title: Hermes Discord so MCP orchestration

branch_policy.reason: Hermes and watchdog orchestration are experimental/development surfaces unless explicitly promoted.

user_story: A user opens Discord and sends `so omp qt-bot fix blah using z-debug`. Hermes parses and authorizes the command, calls the Hermes `so` MCP backend, and replies with the MCP session id. The backend launches/continues OMP or Claude-code through structured MCP tools instead of tmux, watchdog webhook routing, supervisor state, or job-registry CRUD.
hard_constraints: `so` is Discord/Hermes command language, not a z-harness CLI or local binary.
Keep `scripts/hermes/discord_relay.py` and `scripts/hermes/config.py` as the thin parser/authorization layer.
Do not route Discord `so` through Hermes tmux management, watchdog webhook handling, supervisor logic, or the old job registry.
The deprecated files `session.py`, `supervisor.py`, `so_jobs.py`, and `watchdog_webhook.py` remain only as reference and must not be loaded by gateway/discord_relay for `so`.
Automated tests must use fake Discord and fake agent CLI runners; they must not contact real Discord, real OMP, real tmux, or real project repos.
No `REMOTE_VERIFY` tags unless an implementation task explicitly dogfoods `qt-bot` on its remote host.

implementation_tasks.title: Hermes Discord `so` command parser and authorization
